_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored). SSIDs are personal data — never commit the real file.
_passwords_comment: SSID -> wifi password. With a password the watcher joins that network directly (no outage, full throughput-based switching). Without one it can only disassociate + let macOS auto-join, which just escapes the hotspot. This file lives outside the git repo; never commit real passwords.
